name: string
info_desc: string

name: name
info_desc: info_desc

name: melee
info_desc: When in engagement slot: Attacks the enemy in engagement slot.

name: ranged
info_desc: When in support slot: Prefers to attack the enemy in the diagonal support slot，but this attack has 25% chance to be blocked (deal no damage) if that enemy equips with Armor.

name: magic
info_desc: Prefers to attack the enemy in opposite slot and ignore its armor

name: thrash
info_desc: When hitting any enemy with Melee Attack from engagement slot: Deals additional damage to one random enemy in support slot.

name: damage
info_desc: Deals damage to target enemy.

name: damage_all
info_desc: Deals damage to all enemies.

name: destroy
info_desc: Destroy target's Armor of one enemy.

name: thorns
info_desc: When hit by a Melee Attack: Deals damage to the attacker.

name: reach
info_desc: May make Melee Attack from a support slot.

name: cleave
info_desc: When destroying the armor of any enemy: Exceeding damage is dealt to that enemy.

name: flying
info_desc: When attacked by monster without {Flying}: 50% chance to evade Melee Attack and Doublestrike. 25% chance to evade Ranged Attack.

name: shield
info_desc: Reduces damage from Melee or Ranged Attack.

name: counter
info_desc: When receving Melee Damage: 50% chance to deal the same amount of damage to the attacker.

name: reflect
info_desc: When attacked by Magic: 75% chance to receive no damage and deal the same amount of damage to the attacker.

name: disease
info_desc: When dealing Melee，Ranged or Thorns Damage to any enemy: that enemy becomes Diseased (lose Encourage，Demoralize and Magic Reflect. Remove Blessed. This status can be removed by Heal).

name: boost
info_desc: When equipped with Armor: Gain additional Armor.

name: breaker
info_desc: When making Melee or Ranged Attack: Deal additional damage to the Armor，and Ranged Attack will not be be blocked by the Armor.

name: silence
info_desc: When coming into play: Each enemy becomes Silenced (loses Magic Attack and Heal).

name: mshield
info_desc: Reduces damage from Magic Attack.

name: swap
info_desc: When coming into play: the engagement slot enemy swaps position with one random enemy in support slot.

name: draft
info_desc: When coming into play: You gain crystals.

name: immunity
info_desc: May not be the target for a Consumable Card and is immune to Demoralize and Silence.

name: crystal
info_desc: When sacrificed: You gain additional crystals.

name: disease_all
info_desc: When dealing Melee，Ranged or Thorns Damage to any enemy: Each enemy becomes Diseased (lose Encourage，Demoralize and Magic Reflect. Remove Blessed. This status can be removed by Heal).

name: stealth
info_desc: When in support slot: May not be the target for Ranged and Magic Attack.

name: aggro
info_desc: Becomes the preferred target for Ranged Attack.

name: opportunity
info_desc: When the opponent uses Reach or Backstab: Make one Ranged Attack to that enemy. This can trigger only once per turn.

name: magic_aoe
info_desc: When hitting any enemy with Magic Attack: Deal additional damage to its adjacent enemies.

name: disarm
info_desc: When hitting any enemy with Melee Attack or Ranged Attack: Destroys the enemy's weapon.

name: trample
info_desc: When in engagement slot and hitting any enemy with Melee Attack: Deals additional damage to all enemies in support slots.

name: unsummon
info_desc: Target monster returns to its owner's deck.

name: drain_crystal
info_desc: When destorying any enemy: You gain crystals.

name: demoralize
info_desc: At the start of battle phase: Each enemy becomes Demoralized (Melee Attack decreases). Only the strongest Demoralized works if multiple same effects are in play.

name: rally
info_desc: At the start of battle phase: Each ally becomes Encouraged (Melee Attack increases). Only the strongest Encouraged works if multiple same effects are in play.

name: antimagic
info_desc: At the start of battle phase: Each enemy becomes Magic-Supppressed (Magic Attack decreases). Only the strongest Magic-Supppressed works if multiple same effects are in play.

name: charge
info_desc: At the start of battle phase: Becomes Charged (Melee Attack increases) until the end of the opponent's turn. This can trigger only once.

name: regenerate
info_desc: Recovers half of the missing HP

name: cautious
info_desc: At the start of battle phase: Immune to Counter-Attack，Thorns，Entangle and Opportunity until the end of the opponent's turn.

name: heal_all
info_desc: Recovers HP of all allies.

name: heal
info_desc: Recovers HP of one injured ally.

name: repair
info_desc: Repair the armor of one random ally.

name: entangle
info_desc: 50% chance to make the opposite enemy Entangled (loses Flying and skips next battle phase).

name: chance
info_desc: Deals a random amount of damage to one random enemy.
